claim.basis: Current regulator-index inspection bounded to the issuer's SEC submissions; absence of a later operating filing is used only to avoid attributing the technical decline to a verified new issuer disclosure.

evidence.applicability_limit: Applies only to filings present in the SEC submissions index through inspection; it is not evidence that no other public or private causal information exists.
evidence.excerpt: No RTX operating filing follows the July 23 Form 10-Q and Form 8-K through September 15.
evidence.locator: SEC submissions JSON, recent accession and filing-date arrays inspected 2026-09-15
evidence.rationale: The current regulator index supports only the bounded conclusion that no later SEC operating filing explains the alert-period move.

claim.proposition: The SEC submissions index listed no RTX operating filing after the 2026-07-23 Form 10-Q and Form 8-K through inspection on 2026-09-15.
claim.scope: RTX Corporation SEC submission sequence for later operating disclosures
claim.uncertainty: No later SEC operating filing does not exclude undisclosed information, non-SEC public information, sector moves, macro factors, positioning, or liquidity effects.
